PR #27275 (#25910, ruling B 6386223367, 移出) removes `ui/packages/vscode-extension` from the workspace. Its dev report 6471432493 flagged one governed line it deliberately left alone: `skills/objectui/README.md` L59, `- **Tooling:** \`@object-ui/cli\`, \`create-plugin\`, \`vscode-extension\``. Once #27275 merges, that line names a tool that no longer exists. It is the same skill, the same lane and the same kind of retired-package staleness as this card. A one-line edit in the same PR, dropping `vscode-extension`, saves a second Tier H round. If this card's PR lands first, the devx seat files it separately.
